text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui started a three-day visit to Spain.
- Rainy weekend makes farmers hopeful for a good season.
- Tunisia launches a training center for telecommunications with a capacity of 600 youths per year.
- The politburo of the Constitutional Democratic Rallye (ruling party) expected to be reshuffled soon in line with the last shake up in the government's cabinet.
